Author: DylanJames
Description:
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/7330][img]https://files.catbox.moe/kcsfxk.png[/img][/url][/center]

[b][size=4]REQUIREMENTS[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000][b]Central Station[/b][/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/url]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/6074/images/8/8-1785652936-842432422.gif[/img][/center]
[center][/center]

[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Makes a minor consistency edit between [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000][b]Central Station[/b][/url] and [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/b].
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/url][b] [/b]is also given [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000][b]Central Station[/b][/url] support. You can visit [url=https://stardewvalleyexpanded.wiki.gg/wiki/Grampleton_Suburbs][b]Pondwood[/b][/url] from the station.

You can also lower the ticket price to [url=https://stardewvalleyexpanded.wiki.gg/wiki/Grampleton_Suburbs][b]Pondwood[/b][/url] from 1000 to 500.  [i](Default is 1000)[/i]
The destination is unlocked when Scarlett is unlocked as an NPC, just like in the base mod.

[size=1] [/size]
[b][size=4]FREQUENTLY ANTICIPATED QUESTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[quote][b]Q. [/b]Will you add other locations to Central Station?
[b]A. [/b]This is something I did originally. However, there are potential lore reasons (which I won't spoil) provided through in-game dialogue that explain why certain locations are inaccessible. I just wanted to get rid of the duplicate ticket booth.[/quote]
[quote][b]Q. [/b]Will you be making other consistency edits to Central Station?
[b]A. [/b]Probably... I just wanted to get rid of the duplicate ticket booth.[/quote]
[quote][b]Q. [/b]Will you add support for another mod?
[b]A. [/b]I don't know... I just wanted to get rid of the duplicate ticket booth.[/quote][size=1]ㅤ[/size]

[b][size=4]SHOUT-OUTS TO[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
The duplicate ticket booth.
makewordart.com I guess.
